subject: A Block elevator vibration has returned after November repair

messages.body:
Good morning,

The vibration you attended on 23 November has returned on our A Block elevator. Residents report it in the same stretch of travel, on ascent, with the same noise.

Your report on completion stated the rails were within tolerance and that the guide shoes had been replaced. Given the fault has returned within seven weeks we would like you to attend again and look at the rail alignment and bracket fixings this time.

We are treating this as a return to your own work rather than a new job.

Northgate Residence Management

Hello,

Understood, we will attend at no charge as a goodwill visit.

First availability is Tuesday 13 January.

Coastline Elevator Co.

Attended today. We found two rail brackets out of alignment between the fourth and fifth floors and corrected them. Guide shoes were showing uneven wear consistent with that, so we replaced them again.

No charge for this visit.

Coastline Elevator Co.

Thank you for attending at no charge.

For our records: the misaligned brackets you corrected today are in the same stretch of travel that was reported in November, when the rails were assessed as within tolerance. We are noting that on the file.

Northgate Residence Management

outcome_note: The community got the repair for free and still lost eight weeks and paid 520 for a fix that did not address the cause. The committee agreed that evening to stop choosing elevator work on price alone. The agreement was verbal, was never written down anywhere retrievable, and is exactly the kind of institutional decision this project is built to keep.
